BriefInstructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken with yogurt, spices, and lemon juice for 1 hour.
Step 2: Grill or fry the marinated chicken until lightly browned.
Step 3: Heat butter in a pan and sauté onions until golden.
Step 4: Add pureed tomatoes, garlic, and ginger; cook until thickened.
Step 5: Stir in cream and adjust seasoning with salt and spices.
Step 6: Add cooked chicken and simmer for 10 minutes.
Step 7: Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.
Suggestion: Use less butter and cream or replace with yogurt for a healthier version.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Boil potatoes and mash them with spices.
Step 2: Prepare dough with wheat flour, water, and a pinch of salt.
Step 3: Divide the dough into balls and flatten slightly.
Step 4: Stuff each ball with the mashed potato mixture.
Step 5: Roll the stuffed balls into thin parathas.
Step 6: Cook on a hot griddle, brushing with ghee on both sides.
Step 7: Serve hot with yogurt or pickle.
Suggestion: Use less ghee and add grated carrots or spinach for extra nutrition.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Soak kidney beans overnight and boil until soft.
Step 2: Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions until golden.
Step 3: Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Step 4: Stir in pureed tomatoes and cook until thickened.
Step 5: Add spices and salt; mix well.
Step 6: Add boiled beans and simmer for 15 minutes.
Step 7: Garnish with coriander and serve with rice.
Suggestion: Already healthy. Use less oil for a lighter version.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Soak chickpeas overnight and boil until tender.
Step 2: Heat oil and sauté onions until golden brown.
Step 3: Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Step 4: Add pureed tomatoes, spices, and salt; cook until thickened.
Step 5: Stir in boiled chickpeas and simmer for 10 minutes.
Step 6: Prepare dough with flour, water, and salt for bhature.
Step 7: Roll dough into flat rounds and deep fry until golden.
Step 8: Serve hot chickpeas with bhature.
Suggestion: Use baked bread instead of fried bhature for a healthier option.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Cut paneer into cubes and lightly fry them; set aside.
Step 2: Heat butter in a pan and sauté onions until golden.
Step 3: Add pureed tomatoes, ginger, and garlic; cook until thickened.
Step 4: Stir in cream, spices, and salt.
Step 5: Add paneer cubes and cook for 5 minutes.
Step 6: Garnish with coriander and serve with naan or rice.
Suggestion: Use low-fat cream or yogurt to reduce calories.

Suggestion: Use less oil for a healthier option.
